info.title: Search Open Collaboration
info.description: Retrieve all open collaboration information from merchants, including commission rate, add to showcase and post content creator count.

post.description: Retrieve all open collaboration information from merchants, including commission rate, add to showcase and post content creator count.

parameters.name: x-tts-access-token
parameters.description: The seller access_token value from [Get Access Token](https://partner.tiktokshop.com/docv2/page/678e3a3292b0f40314a92d75#Get%20Access%20Token%20API), when user_type = 0. Follow this [guide](https://partner.tiktokshop.com/docv2/page/678e3a344ddec3030b238fa0) to get seller access_token.

parameters.name: app_key
parameters.description: Every single app will have a unique key. Please use the specific key assigned to your app.

parameters.name: sign
parameters.description: Signature generated by gen algorithm. When you send API requests to TTS, you must sign them so that TTS can identify the senders.

parameters.name: timestamp
parameters.description: Unix timestamp GMT (UTC+00:00). This timestamp is used across all API requests. Developers can use this convert to local time.

parameters.name: page_token
parameters.description: Pagination offset determines where you begin to search for. It's empty when you raise your first request.

parameters.name: page_size
parameters.description: The value of "page_size" must be greater than 0 and less than or equal to 100.

parameters.name: sort_order
parameters.description:
Default value of "sort_order" is DESC.
Enum:
- ASC：means to sort data in ascending order
- DESC：means to sort data in descending order

parameters.name: sort_field
parameters.description:
Some sorting fields are as follows:
- product_original_price: sort by products' original price.
By default, the open collaborations are sorted in descending order by creation time.

parameters.name: shop_cipher
parameters.description:
Use this property to pass shop information in requesting the API. Failure in passing the correct value when requesting the API for cross-border shops will return incorrect response. 
Get by API [Get Authorization Shop](https://partner.tiktokshop.com/docv2/page/6507ead7b99d5302be949ba9?external_id=6507ead7b99d5302be949ba9)

parameters.name: body
parameters.description: Request body. Full source table is retained in x-tiktok-request-body-parameters.

keyword_type.description:
Pass in the parameter type which you use to query open collaborations. 
You can query based on:
- PRODUCT_ID：If you use PRODUCT_ID  to search, you can search for open collaboration information for a specified product ID.
- PRODUCT_NAME: If you use PRODUCT_NAME to search, you can fuzzy search for open collaboration information involving related product names.

keyword.description: Search based on the product name or product ID. Pass in the appropriate value based on the keyword_type above.

top_level_category_id.description:
The category of the searched product needs to be limited in this param.
Prerequisites:
- The value of field category_id must be greater than 0.
- Currently, it only supports first-level categories

200.description: Successful response. See source Markdown for complete semantics.

code.description: The success or failure status code returned in API response.

message.description: The success or failure messages returned in API response. Reasons of failure will be described in the message.

total_count.description: Total count of products that satisfy all the input search conditions.

status.description:
Status of open collaboration. 
Field values:
- NORMAL：NORMAL means the current open collaboration status is normal and in effect.
- TERMINATING: TERMINATING means that the merchant has removed open collaboration and the open collaboration will expire soon. The expiration time can be found at the end_time of current_commission.
The open collaborations which were removed and expired will not be returned in the response.

rate.description:
The commission rate for this product is set by merchants for creators' public promotion.
The range of this value is [100, 8000].
This value is expressed in 1/10000 increments. For example: 3000 means the actual commission rate is 30.00%, and 3555 means 35.55%

start_time.description: The time when the commission rate becomes effective.

end_time.description: The effective end time of the commission rate.

current_commission.description: The commission information is currently in effect for this open collaboration.

showcase_creator_count.description: This field indicates the number of creators who added the product to the showcase from open collaboration.

content_creator_count.description: This field indicates the number of creators who posted the LIve or Video from open collaboration.

status.description:
Product's status.
Field values:
- LIVE: When the product is normal for sale, return to the LIVE status
- OUT_OF_STOCK: When the product is out of stock for the consumer, the OUT_OF_STOCK state is returned
- SELLER_DEACTIVATE:  When the product is deactivated by the merchant, the SELLER_DEACTIVATE status is returned
- PLATFORM_DEACTIVATE: When the product is deactivated by the platform or is not available for sale, the PLATFORM_DEACTIVATE status is returned
- GNE_REJECT: When the product is governed or the open collaboration is dismissed, the GNE_REJECT state is returned
- DELETE: When the product is deleted, the DELETE status is returned
- OTHER: When the product is in an unsaleable state, such as draft, frozen, review, etc, the OTHER status is returned

minimum_amount.description: The minimum original price of all skus of this product.

maximum_amount.description: The maximum original price of all skus of this product.

product.description: The open collaboration bound product information.
